hook.replicable_formula: Imagine having to [awkward thing the person in the news did]. Then [the market fallout]. And now [the new twist].

analysis.first_frame: Talking-head creator over a large photo of the CEO, label 'Con las manos en la masa', a news headline card with outlet name, and the first caption word, all on screen
analysis.onscreen_hook: Con las manos en la masa
analysis.spoken_first_line: Imagínate tener que confesar públicamente que le fuiste infiel a tu esposa.
analysis.why_it_works: Second-person 'imagine' puts the viewer inside the week's scandal, and a real headline card at 0 s proves it is news. (Uses a real person's photo, which we don't do.)

hook.replicable_formula: The market is [blunt verb]. [Index] is now [milestone number] for the year, and [N] forces are colliding.

analysis.first_frame: Selfie outdoors, big white box with 'The Market is F*cking Collapsing' (last word red) already on screen
analysis.onscreen_hook: The Market is F*cking Collapsing
analysis.spoken_first_line: The market is collapsing, the NASDAQ is now negative for the year and there are three massive...
analysis.why_it_works: A blunt alarm at 0 s, then a concrete milestone and a numbered promise ('three pressures') that makes you stay for the list. (Profanity and alarm tone are not ours.)

hook.replicable_formula: Is [the sell-off] happening on purpose? [Who] gains [$X] if [rates/prices] fall.

analysis.first_frame: Dark chart card 'CRASHING ON PURPOSE?' with a rising green line, and a stick figure labelled with a politician's name pulling a lever, 'MY OPINION' tag
analysis.onscreen_hook: CRASHING ON PURPOSE?
analysis.spoken_first_line: [Politician] is crashing the stock market on purpose to prevent the government from paying $1 trillion...
analysis.why_it_works: A hidden-motive question with a big dollar figure turns a sell-off into a puzzle; the animated lever-and-chart is understood instantly. (Speculative political claim; we only report sourced reasons.)

hook.replicable_formula: The dip wasn't the dip: [company] [-X%] today.

analysis.first_frame: Creator holding his head over a broker app screenshot: NVIDIA $127.34, red -12.77% today, caption 'The dip wasn't the dip'
analysis.onscreen_hook: The dip wasn't the dip
analysis.spoken_first_line: My bad, I thought the dip was the dip.
analysis.why_it_works: A self-deprecating line every dip-buyer recognises, with the real red price and % visible at 0 s as the punchline's proof.

hook.replicable_formula: Everyone wanted [company] at $[peak]. Now no one wants it at $[now].

analysis.first_frame: Talking head under the company logo and serif headline 'Everyone wanted it at $243', small price card already counting ($188)
analysis.onscreen_hook: Everyone wanted it at $243
analysis.spoken_first_line: Everyone wanted it at 243, and now no one wants it at 163.
analysis.why_it_works: A then-vs-now price pair puts the whole fall in two numbers and flips crowd sentiment; the counting price card moves from frame 0.

hook.replicable_formula: [Actor] is [verb]ing this [market move]. The reason: $[big number] in [thing].

analysis.first_frame: Dim White House photo; the headline, heatmap and speaker cut-out arrive by 0.5 s (frame 0 is nearly empty)
analysis.onscreen_hook: TRUMP IS FORCING THIS MARKET CRASH
analysis.spoken_first_line: Donald Trump is purposely forcing this stock market crash and the reason has everything to do with the $11 trillion in American debt...
analysis.why_it_works: A loud motive claim stacked on a red heatmap with a date stamp; it works despite a nearly empty frame 0. (Speculative political claim and a real politician's image, which we don't do.)

hook.replicable_formula: [Actor] is [doing X] on purpose to avoid paying $[N]. Here are the facts.

analysis.first_frame: Silhouette over a red stock-board background on top half, creator talking below, caption 'Donald Trump is'
analysis.onscreen_hook: Trump is crashing the market on purpose
analysis.spoken_first_line: Donald Trump is crashing a stock market on purpose to prevent the government from paying one trillion dollars...
analysis.why_it_works: Hidden-motive claim plus 'let me show you the facts' promises proof; a third reel with the same take this week, so the narrative itself was the hook. (Speculative; not for us.)

hook.replicable_formula: [Market] went from green to red in one session: watch [N]% of stocks flip.

analysis.first_frame: Black frame, red-and-white headline 'Bloodbath in US', a market heatmap still mostly green, and a subtitle line
analysis.onscreen_hook: Bloodbath in US
analysis.spoken_first_line: (sound only)
analysis.why_it_works: A heatmap that visibly turns from green to red in 3 s is the whole story with sound off; the headline tells you what you're watching.

hook.replicable_formula: [Index] lost $[X], its worst week in [period]: everything that happened in [N] seconds.

analysis.first_frame: Motion-blurred creator on the exchange floor with an empty white title box and a date tag 'Fri 11/20' (headline fills by 0.5 s)
analysis.onscreen_hook: The S&P 500 lost $2.4 trillion, worst week in over a year
analysis.spoken_first_line: Stock market got throttled again today. Here's everything you need to know that happened on Wall Street in 60-ish seconds.
analysis.why_it_works: A dated headline with a red dollar figure plus a 60-second promise; the exchange setting signals real news. Its blank title box at 0 s is the weak spot.

hook.replicable_formula: Then $[peak] / Now $[current]: [company] down [X]%. [N] more like it.

analysis.first_frame: 'Then' / 'Now' red and green pills, a ticker card NVDA $243.37 'Previous High', red 'Down: 48.4%', and 'Biggest Stocks on Discount' box, all at 0 s
analysis.onscreen_hook: Then / Now: $243.37, Down 48.4%
analysis.spoken_first_line: Everybody wanted Nvidia at 243, but nobody wanted it at 126.
analysis.why_it_works: Then-vs-now cards with a red percentage give the drop in one glance, and a list promise ('biggest stocks') holds for the next ticker. (Buy-the-dip angle is advice; we only report.)

hook.replicable_formula: [Positive frame] ([what everyone else sees]). [Company] is down [X]% from its high.

analysis.first_frame: Talking head under a big serif headline 'Generational opportunity (Stocks are crashing)'
analysis.onscreen_hook: Generational opportunity (Stocks are crashing)
analysis.spoken_first_line: Nvidia is down 36% from its high, the lowest it's been this year.
analysis.why_it_works: Headline contradicts the mood (opportunity vs crash), then a precise drawdown number grounds it. (Advice framing; we'd keep the contradiction, drop the call.)

hook.replicable_formula: The same [fund/company] that [lost $X] in [month] just [did it again]. Here's how.

analysis.first_frame: Black frame with a photo card of a fund manager, caption 'Situational Awareness lost everything AGAIN', creator talking below
analysis.onscreen_hook: Situational Awareness lost everything AGAIN
analysis.spoken_first_line: The same hedge fund that got liquidated for $40 billion back in July just blew up again, and you will not believe how this happened.
analysis.why_it_works: A sequel story ('again') with a dollar loss and 'you won't believe how' opens a loop that only the reel closes.

hook.replicable_formula: $[X] wiped out of [market] today. [Index] down [Y]% this [period]: [milestone].

analysis.first_frame: Black frame, X-post screenshot 'MASSIVE WIPEOUT: $2 trillion crash in the US stock market today' over a red heatmap with big-tech logos and % moves
analysis.onscreen_hook: $2 trillion crash in the US stock market today
analysis.spoken_first_line: Over $2 trillion has been wiped out of the US stock market today, with the Nasdaq down over 13% this month and in correction territory.
analysis.why_it_works: Dollar wipeout headline plus a logo heatmap at 0 s, then a second number (13%) and a named milestone (correction) in the first sentence.

hook.replicable_formula: [Day + time the viewer's market opens] alert: what [last night's move] means for you.

analysis.first_frame: Talking head at a desk under a white box 'MONDAY 9:15 AM ALERT' with a siren
analysis.onscreen_hook: MONDAY 9:15 AM ALERT
analysis.spoken_first_line: (transcript unreadable: Hindi/Urdu about the US sell-off and Nvidia's fall)
analysis.why_it_works: A time-stamped alert tied to the viewer's own market open (India) makes overseas news feel urgent and local.

hook.replicable_formula: [Market] just had its worst [period] since [famous event]. Here's what actually happened.

analysis.first_frame: Talking head under a serif headline 'The Worst Week in the Market Since Covid / But Don't Panic Sale!' with siren icons
analysis.onscreen_hook: The Worst Week in the Market Since Covid, But Don't Panic Sell!
analysis.spoken_first_line: Do not sell anything until you watch this. So yes, the market just had its worst week since COVID.
analysis.why_it_works: Names the viewer's fear and a historic comparison at 0 s, then promises calm context. (We'd keep the comparison, never the 'don't sell' advice.)

hook.replicable_formula: When you [everyday feeling] but then you check [the red market].

analysis.first_frame: Office worker on his phone, caption 'When you lose motivation to work but then you look at your stock portfolio' already on screen; a red stocks app appears at 2 s
analysis.onscreen_hook: When you lose motivation to work but then you look at your stock portfolio
analysis.spoken_first_line: (no speech)
analysis.why_it_works: A relatable office moment that every investor in a red week recognises; readable at 0 s with sound off.

hook.replicable_formula: "How do you know [who] is in control of [company]'s [event]?"

analysis.first_frame: Close-up in a dark hoodie, quoted question 'How do you know sellers are in control of NVIDIA earnings?'
analysis.onscreen_hook: How do you know sellers are in control of NVIDIA earnings?
analysis.spoken_first_line: (music)
analysis.why_it_works: A quoted viewer-style question promises an insider tell; the face holds a frozen 'look' that sets up an answer.

hook.replicable_formula: When [people around you] ask why you [invest/trade] this week.

analysis.first_frame: Letterboxed news clip of a politician gesturing, caption 'When your family and friends ask why you trade'
analysis.onscreen_hook: When your family and friends ask why you trade
analysis.spoken_first_line: (news clip audio)
analysis.why_it_works: Meme caption on a recognisable clip; instant in-group joke for traders. (Footage of a real politician; not for us.)

hook.replicable_formula: [Famous investor/fund] just bought $[big number] of this $[price] stock. Which one?

analysis.first_frame: Green box in caps 'WATCH OUT!!! WARREN BUFFETT'S COMPANY BUYS $930,000,000 OF THIS $44 STOCK!!!' over a famous investor photo, creator reacting below
analysis.onscreen_hook: Buffett's company buys $930,000,000 of this $44 stock
analysis.spoken_first_line: Warren Buffett's company just bought 930 million dollars of this $44 stock and I might have to copy him.
analysis.why_it_works: A huge dollar figure next to a small share price plus a hidden ticker is a curiosity gap with two numbers. (Hype caps and 'copy him' are not our voice.)

hook.replicable_formula: [Company] now $[price]. The level to watch: [reveal]. 1 of [N].

analysis.first_frame: Plain talking head with a mic; no text at 0 s (the price card with a blurred target appears at 0.5 s, with a 1/5 progress bar)
analysis.onscreen_hook: NVIDIA, now $125.53, my level hidden then revealed
analysis.spoken_first_line: If Nvidia drops to this price, if Apple drops to this price...
analysis.why_it_works: A blurred number that unblurs plus a '1/5' progress bar is a visible open loop. (Price targets are advice; we'd use the reveal for a sourced number.)
